Today, we released the Version 1.11 update for Borderlands 4. This update includes updates to Story Pack 2: FL4K and the Last Resort* content to keep a smooth gameplay experience, and balance adjustments for Loveless the Hacker*, the newest Vault Hunter. We've resolved progression blockers, adjusted boss fights, and improved tracking to get you to the new objective. For Loveless, we've updated Contagion, shuriken, and Wyrm pet AI behaviors. We've also made balance changes to other Vault Hunters.
Please restart your game to ensure that the update goes through and to prevent connection errors in matchmaking.
If you're encountering any issues, please contact 2K Support for direct assistance. You can also read the PC Troubleshooting Guide, a list of known issues, or browse a list of Support threads here.

notes.title: Story Pack 2: FL4K and the Last Resort*

items.text: Mr. Chew joins the fight when traveling with you.
The mission will start as expected in multiplayer when it is the first time the host is playing FL4K and the Last Resort content.
Spawning to Providence Island is only accessible to those with paid content ownership.
Updated Objectives not progressing due to killing enemies ahead of time or reaching areas ahead of Mr. Chew.
Updated missions to keep their current states after reloading into the map with a save/load.
Doors will unlock and elevator buttons will be interactable when they're supposed to.

A reported case of invincibility has been removed from Lieutenant Harmony when she goes into her second phase of combat. She also no longer dodges throwing knives, and her Blade Attack will continue to harm you when standing close to the edge.
Killing Lieutenant Harmony Mission Objective will complete when using C4SH's "Vampiric Touch" Card when in Windfall.
Ducky's combat will not start until you enter the arena.
Lieutenant Bume will spawn during Tediore Digi-Rift World Events instead of Megan.
Drilla Killa's will to survive after reaching 1HP has been removed. He will appropriately die when you've done enough damage to him.
Dr. Elena Smith spawns immediately after reloading the map from UVHM.
Tediore Employees will stay hostile towards you.
Spaced out enemies when fighting near The Keeper's Ear Fast Travel Station.
Enemies will join combat when fighting another group on the road near FL4K's Sanctum.
Unstable Ordonite damage no longer scales with player level and causes you to go down from touching it.
Corrosive explosive plants will damage you if hit too close.
Ocean water will no longer deal damage to you.
Substation Control door will only unlock when all Substation Switches are activated and the icon will show as complete for all players on the big map.
All players are able to pick up the Ordonite Bomb in multiplayer during "The Rescue".
Digi-Rift portals will disappear for all players when they're not able to be grappled into.
You can see ECHO-4's progress when hacking The Surly Centipede Tiki Bar, and the objective will stay active if you leave the green circle.
Camera will only shake for the person on the zipline in multiplayer.
Added a zipline to exit the porn stash area quickly.
Corrected some grapple points that weren't functioning and added a grapple during "The Tainted Truth".
Your location will match the Big Map inside the shrink rift.
Pyroclast Field will show as discovered when you're entering that area.
Updated cinematics for better ragdoll and cloth animation and focus.

notes.title: Bounty Pack 5: Amara and the Vile Shadows**

items.text: Bosses from Amara and the Vile Shadows are available when selecting Big Encore on the Moxxi Replay Machine.
Dive attacks from Skydrift Threshers will damage players.
The Thresher Experiment will make use of a flying spin attack in combat.
Defeating Reject Prototypes will unlock the second Fast Travel Station in Amara and the Vile Shadows and the large rift will continue to work.
Test Alpha will no longer spawn enemies from other paid content.
Active siphon orbs will damage you if you stand too close.
Lava pools will cause damage if you stand in them.
Rifts for traveling in and out of the Phase will display the proper effects and icons and will stay visible when viewed close up.
The Rift in the room before the boss will remain present through save/loads and when getting killed during the Test Zero fight.
Interactive objects will show their green highlights.
Objectives will only be visible when they're active, and the Kill the Thresher Experiment will progress as intended.
ECHO logs will not reappear after quitting to the main menu.
A lever has been added to both sides of the shield during The Rift Crisis mission so it can be disabled from either side.
Prevented some instances of Clarion Wardens getting knocked out of the arena (looking at you, Harlowe players) to prevent a blocker on mission progress.
More Salt Licker enemy variants will spawn in the Toxic Scowl. Firebrands, Sluggers, and Badass Psychos will now appear.
Skank Eyes will continue fighting players during his fight, regardless of where they are.

notes.title: Bounty Pack 3: A Zane To Kill For****

items.text: Closed boss arena exit doors.
Fast Traveling will complete before your character loads in, allowing you to start moving immediately.

Horace's health pools have been adjusted. The secondary health pool from the first stage of the fight has been reduced, while the second stage heath pool has been increased. This results in a shorter flying stage and longer grounded stage.
Added a bank in the Takedown at Hadron Abyss lobby.
Addressed some instances of the Black Market Vending Machine being filled with inconsistent gear.
Lilith will only teleport you once after defeating Arjay and saving/quitting.
Vault entrances only appear after picking up three Vault Key Fragments.
Eridium mining drones spawn on top of terrain so you can keep the objective going during "Crystal Brawl" Mission.
Prevented the game from resuming before you're ready at the menu when connection is lost in single player.
The camera won't clip into your shoulder-mounted weapon when reviving a downed player.

We've done a pass over the new content released in the previous update to identify and correct areas that were dropping items, taking you out of the map, avoiding conflict, or getting you and enemies stuck so you can keep playing across base and paid content.
We moved around some objects that defied gravity or clipped with the scenery around them.
Challenges that were not progressing properly have been updated.
Updated ECHOlocation guides and waypoints on various missions.
All unlocked Heads and Skins will share with Loveless when creating a character with Shared Progression.
Kittycopter heads are able to be equipped if previously unlocked.
Candlenight Catastrophe can be unlocked with Vault Card tickets and equipped.
Corpses of frozen enemies killed by Loveless' Contagion will no longer linger.
Trait - RAM
Contagion grants RAM.
Skills
Virology, Green Tree
Plague Star
Plague Star Shuirkens will no longer remain floating in the air after being thrown during intense combat.
Prevented Contagion effects from being stuck in the air.
Contagion Executable Damage deals 33% increased Damage.
Augments
d://File: Accurately changes the shuriken's damage to radiation.

Dev Note: We decided to remove Hazards from D://File after finding a serious issue that could impact performance. We pivoted to make this skill instead lean in on the fantasy of applying Radiation Status Effects (which have AOE DoTs), which should enable a whole bunch of new and exciting builds!
Lag Switch: Damage has been increased by 66%.
Passives
Unsupported Peripheral: Tossing grenades will follow the camera direction for a more predictable throw, instead of straight ahead.

Clarified in the tooltip that this is a damage multiplier and not additive.
Hack / Slash, Blue Tree
Visual Paradox Nexus

Capstone

Augments

Passives

Target Practice: Shurikens thrown by Clones have the intended visuals and animations.
Refactored Damage Formula: Changed to be 1.5/2.0x Damage and clarified the tooltip to reflect this.

Dev Note: We didn't want to fully make it mandatory to use Montage Maker to tangibly benefit from this skill. We decided to take a middle ground approach to make the passive more accessible for more Class Mods.
The Sweet Science: Will apply a Status Effect to enemies damaged when attacking with Empowered Melee.
Merry Bandwidth: Updated Skill Description to account for the existing Clone summoned by Loveless.
Manifestation, Red Tree
Malignant Construct

Wyrm will better respond to the ping function when using it to switch Wyrm's target during the Executable attack.

Capstone

Wyrm will consistently stay visible when falling off a cliff and when near bodies of water.
Updated to make this skill more responsive, and added a follow for Breath Attacks when enemies back down out of range.
Using this ability will not prevent you from changing Action Skills, Augments, and Capstones while they are not active.

Augments

Continued improvements to stability and optimization.

Today, we released our second Raid Boss fight featuring Subjugator and Thol the Invincible! Additionally, we added UVHM7, a Shared Progression Toggle, enhanced several Vault Hunters’ skills, updated weapon interactions, and more. If that’s not enough to fuel your hunt, a number of brand-new Pearlescents are now obtainable through any loot source that provides weapons.
In this update, we also made significant strides to provide you with a more consistent combat experience. Some key changes are:
Reworked XP rewards from some of our toughest challenges.
A tune-up to C4SH’s skills.
Updates to the Bod Shotgun and Torgue Sticky projectiles
Please restart your game to ensure the update goes through and to prevent connection errors in matchmaking.
If you encounter issues, please contact 2K Support for direct assistance. You can also read the PC Troubleshooting Guide, a list of known issues, or browse a list of Support threads here.

notes.title: Raid Boss 2: Subjugator and Thol the Invincible

items.text: Subjugator and Thol the Invincible have long been languishing in their service to the Timekeeper. They’ve spent ages isolated on an island off the coast of the Fadefields, waiting for a worthy challenger to come along: you, Vault Hunter.

This encounter starts with you facing off against both bosses at the same time, but as one dies, you’ll be taken to the real boss battle. We’ll be testing your skills and endurance in this new fight, and pushing them to the limit.You can read more details in this Subjugator and Thol the Invincible article.

Subjugator and Thol introduce new legendaries, Firmware, and a new Pearlescent that can all be farmed as dedicated drops. Similar to Bloomreaper, you’ll only receive some of the gear if you can complete the fight in a short-enough time and at a high-enough difficulty level. Depending on your completion time, the Bronze, Silver, Gold, or Platinum-tier rewards you get from this chest will be increasingly powerful. You'll be able to clearly see how much time you have left to hit a certain tier via your mission tracker.
Here's a breakdown of the Raid Boss 2 content arriving with Version 1.7:
Support for the addition of Raid Boss 2: Thol and Subjugator the Invincible.
Players must complete the Main Campaign before jumping into Raid content. This will be a tough fight, so make sure you’ve got your best gear equipped!
UVHM 7, a new level available to unlock for those at UVHM 6!
Complete the Mission for Subjugator and Thol the Invincible in UVHM 6 to play this new difficulty.
We’ve scaled this level up to better align with the additional gear and levels added to the game since launch.
Ripper SMG Jail-Broken Gatling
Torgue Assault Rifle Lockjaw
Tediore Pistol Shammy Kablammy
Vladof Heavy Weapon Ordnance Flak Cannon
Order Shield Collector
Each Vault Hunter has a unique Class Mod in Subjugator and Thol the Invincible's loot table.

When the sixth Vault Hunter joins Borderlands 4 as part of Story Pack 2* in Q3 2026, a Class Mod unique to them will also be added to this same pool of possible Subjugator and Thol the Invincible drops.
Active Fire: At Tier 3, unleashing a charge weapon's full-charge shot the moment it's available will deal bonus damage, providing increased lethality as a reward for your precision timing.

Ordonite corruption is spreading throughout Kairos, and as a result, new treasures await Vault Hunters, including new Pearlescent weaponry! Fight your way through the enemies of Kairos, open each and every container, and dig your way through piles of trash in search of these new Pearls. They can be anywhere!

As a refresher, Shared Character Progression was added in the 1.5 Update and allowed progression for Collectibles, Activities, Map Progress, SDU tokens, Vault Powers, Vehicle skins, and Hover Drives across all of your Vault Hunters.

We've heard the community's desire for Shared Character Progression to be optional so that starting fresh with a new Vault Hunter is still possible. This update makes this toggle available, starting today, when creating a new Vault Hunter. Thanks for your patience as we worked to make sure this feature accommodated players no matter their preference of playstyle!

This new Shared Progression Toggle will be available when creating a New Character, after you select your difficulty. Please note that this setting cannot be changed after the character creation process is completed.
You can see (via tooltip) if a character has Shared Progression active when selecting the save you’d like to play.
* Free for all Borderlands 4 players. Base game required. Terms apply.

We updated the descriptions of several Class Mods to more precisely explain how their bonuses work. Our goal in doing so was to make it easier to plan your perfect Vault Hunter build. This will be an ongoing process across Borderlands 4 as we identify items that can be better explained to improve your experience. We made other minor tweaks as well:
The Respec Machine completely resets all augment slots alongside your skill points
Skill Tree descriptions use the term “incendiary” for consistency

We are giving C4SH a big tune-up! This update helps with skill tracking, improves how your cards target enemies, and makes sure your abilities scale into the late game. We also rebalanced a few skill combinations so your combat numbers stay powerful without breaking the game's challenge.
Skills
Infinite Bleed C4SH

We found that several skills players have been pairing with the Gamer Class Mod led to situations where enemies bled out significantly faster than we intended. There were multiple causes for this, and after taking a close look, we’re introducing updates that will result in the Gamer Class Mod functioning more along the original lines we intended. Specifically:
Can’t Stop Winning: Triggers specifically from Gun and Action Skill damage, and applies its Critical Hit chance exclusively to Action Skills
Sounds of Rain: Applies its Critical Hit chance to Action Skills
Call: Excludes Status Effect damage from scoring Critical Hits
Roll the Bones - Green Tree
Serendipity: Healing missiles from Serendipity heal C4SH if you kill an enemy while driving a vehicle
Tooth and Nail: Applies its bonus melee damage whenever you fire the Maliwan Shotgun Mantra
Luck of the Draw - Blue Tree
Magic Missile Cards hit Splice enemies that have lost their upper bodies

Dev Note: In the weeks to come before our second raid encounter, we’re going to be introducing some gear tuning and also some gear changes. The changes we can include with Weekly Updates will contain the numerical tuning passes, while the larger updates (such as the QOL update and the Raid Boss 2 update) can contain code changes for our gear systems. Starting off this week is a tuning pass to some of our DLC gear, our Pistols and SMGs, and the Order Manufacturer.

While rapid-fire weapons have benefitted greatly from synergistic Vault Hunter passives, we wanted to make sure our hard-hitting weapons also got some love. We’re starting with a few of the Legendaries that exist in the mid-fire-rate range, then moving to other archetypes like DoTs and Splash Damage.

A note for the future: We have a change coming in the Version 1.7 Update that will cap the damage increase on Torgue Stickies to 200% bonus. Builds that infinitely regenerate ammo could stack the Torgue sticky bonus way beyond the intended means.

A note on percentages: we’ve used percentages below when the adjusted numbers don’t match up with what you see on item cards due to scaling. For example, a Shield might have had its capacity changed from 0.9 to 1.1, resulting in a ~22% increase. This “1.1” value is not shared on the item card, but we want to share what you can expect to see on changed gear (a ~22% difference to the number).
